arStrings.szText: While {c_important}Army of the Dead{/c} is active, your {c_important}Minions{/c} take {c_number}[SF_36*100|%|]{/c} reduced damage and you deal {c_number}[SF_37*100|%x|]{/c} increased Summon Damage.

{c_important}Army of the Dead{/c} will converge on your target. Each time a {c_important}Volatile Skeleton{/c} explodes on an enemy, they take {c_number}[SF_42*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage from your {c_important}Army of the Dead{/c}, up to {c_number}[SF_41*SF_42*100|%x|]{/c}.
{c_important}Army of the Dead{/c} now deals {c_number}{payload:EXPLOSION_DAMAGE_COLD}{/c} Cold damage and {c_important}{u}Freezes{/c}{/u} enemies instead of Stunning them.
{c_important}Army of the Dead{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_40*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage for each {c_important}Minion{/c} you have.
{c_important}Army of the Dead's{/c} Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}{SF_34}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Army of the Dead{/c} passively summons a {c_important}Volatile Skeleton{/c} every {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Army of the Dead{/c} has a {c_number}[{SF_39} * 100|%|]{/c} chance to form a Corpse.
